The consistency is evaluated at points sampled along rays used for volume rendering, linking the geometric prior directly to the rendering process .
The specific formulations of SRDF-SDF consistency and Density Consistency Loss appear in recent literature (circa 2023) focusing on fine-detail reconstruction and multi-view consistency .

The Geometry Bias Loss is specifically associated with methods that combine volume rendering with SDF-based surface extraction, aiming to align the probabilistic surface from rendering with the deterministic surface from the SDF .
